items.claim: Mateusz Gamrot is one of the best grapplers in the welterweight division.
items.quote: He's one of the best grapplers at welterweight right now.

items.claim: Mateusz Gamrot has a relentless grappling style comparable to Merab Dvalishvili.
items.quote: Mateusz Gamrot is a relentless grappler. I've always called him kind of like the Merab of the 170 division

items.claim: Jeremiah Wells has not been very active recently.
items.quote: I don't think Jeremiah Wells has been that active as well. Maybe I'm mistaken him, but I swear he's not fought in a good minute.
